scenario: A `call` action arrives at the integrator-side call callback with the right service / correlation / body. Pins IDSP.6 dispatch contract end-to-end.
rules_ds:
service ha.switch.turn_on:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call ha.switch.turn_on entity_id: "switch.fan" nocooldown as "fan-on"
